cues.zh: 我身后是一片水域，叫Strid。
cues.en: Behind me is a bit of water called the Strid.

cues.zh: 英国有好几处Strid，
cues.en: There are a couple of Strids in Britain,

cues.zh: 但这是约克郡博尔顿修道院沃夫河上的那一处。
cues.en: but this is the one on the River Wharfe, at Bolton Abbey in Yorkshire.

cues.zh: 我认为这是地球上最危险的一片水域。
cues.en: And I reckon it is the most dangerous stretch of water anywhere on Earth.

cues.zh: 我知道，这话说得很大胆。
cues.en: Now that's a bold claim, I know.

cues.zh: 确实有些河流夺走了更多生命，
cues.en: There are certainly rivers that have taken more lives,

cues.zh: 也有些急流和瀑布几乎没船能航行。
cues.en: and there are rapids and waterfalls that few boats could ever sail.

cues.zh: 但一般来说，你能提前看到它们。
cues.en: But generally, you can see them coming.

cues.zh: 而这里只是树林中一条看似无害的小溪。
cues.en: This is just an innocent looking stream in the middle of some woods.

cues.zh: 你本可以跳过去。偶尔也有人这么做。
cues.en: You could jump over it. People occasionally do.

cues.zh: 但要是没跳过去，它就会要你的命。
cues.en: But if you miss that jump, it'll kill you.

cues.zh: 这是上游约一百米处河流的样子。
cues.en: This is what the river looks like about a hundred metres upstream.

cues.zh: 同一条河。那些水全都流下去了。
cues.en: Same river. All that water went down.

cues.zh: 由于当地的地质条件，河流基本上翻转了过来，
cues.en: Thanks to the local geology, the river basically turns on its side,

cues.zh: 在下方岩石中冲刷出通道和隧道。
cues.en: gouging out passages and tunnels in the rocks below.

cues.zh: 那些河岸其实是悬空的岩壁：
cues.en: Those banks are actually overhangs:

cues.zh: 水面下方根本不是浅河床，
cues.en: there isn't any riverbed just below the surface,

cues.zh: 而是一大片深不见底、翻滚汹涌的致命急流。
cues.en: it's a deep, boiling mass of fast and deadly currents.

cues.zh: 有人声称，掉进去的致死率是 100%。
cues.en: There are claims that falling in has a 100% fatality rate.

cues.zh: 这当然无法证实，
cues.en: There's no way to confirm that, of course,

cues.zh: 毕竟“当地人没淹死在河里”算不上什么新闻，
cues.en: because "local person doesn't die in river" doesn't make the news,

cues.zh: 但它确实吞噬了许多生命：
cues.en: but it has claimed a lot of lives:

cues.zh: 甚至有 12 世纪的传说提到，一名小男孩——
cues.en: there are even tales from the 12th century of a young boy,

cues.zh: 也就是未来的苏格兰国王，
cues.en: set to be the future king of Scotland,

cues.zh: 在试图跳过这片水域时丧命。
cues.en: who died trying to jump across those waters.

cues.zh: 而且任何掉进去的东西或人，
cues.en: And anything, or anyone, that falls in

cues.zh: 捞出来时可能都面目全非了：
cues.en: might not come out in any recognisable form:

cues.zh: 水下的礁石可能会将其彻底撞得粉碎，
cues.en: it could just get pulverised against the rocks underwater

cues.zh: 一次又一次，永无休止。
cues.en: over and over and over again.

cues.zh: 我本想放个相机下去拍拍看，
cues.en: I'd try and put a camera in,

cues.zh: 但我可不想靠河边太近。
cues.en: but then I'd have to get close to the edge.

cues.zh: 边缘并不陡峭，只是顺着弧度滑向水面，
cues.en: And the edge isn't sharp, it just curves towards the water

cues.zh: 而且上面长满了湿滑的苔藓。
cues.en: and it's covered in slippery moss.

cues.zh: 此外，水质浑浊，被泥炭染成了褐色，
cues.en: Besides, the water is opaque and brown with peat stain,

cues.zh: 你什么也看不清。
cues.en: you'd see nothing.

cues.zh: 能活下来吗？也许吧，得靠全套装备和极大的运气。
cues.en: Is it survivable? Maybe, with a lot of equipment and a lot of luck.

cues.zh: 你偶尔也能看到一些鲁莽之人的自述，
cues.en: And you'll find occasional testimony from foolhardy people

cues.zh: 说在较干燥的日子里，去底下相对平静的水潭游过泳——
cues.en: who've swum in the calmer pools at the bottom on drier days --

cues.zh: 但在 2010 年，也正是在那里，有个小孩子溺亡了。
cues.en: but that's also where a young child drowned back in 2010.

cues.zh: 这就是它如此危险的原因。
cues.en: That's why it's so dangerous.

cues.zh: 它看着很安全，看着很诱人，
cues.en: It looks safe, it looks tempting,

cues.zh: 但却能要了你的命。
cues.en: and it'll kill you.
